links.note: The threshers note - machines doing threshing and winnowing at once - is attached to the winnowing section, 32751, not to 32750.
Bran out of wheat flour before kneading meethi puri is 32752's own scene.
One of the three questions 32752 puts to the reader about the sieve: whether the particles passing differ in size from those retained.
Clear liquid off a settled solid, by tilting or by filter: 32756 defines sedimentation and decantation together and then names filtration.
Iron filings out of sugar with a magnet - magnetic separation, 32760. Handpicking (32749) is the wrong choice precisely because the filings are many and tiny.
Filter paper's finer pores against a cloth weave - the comparison 32757 makes.
Nani's house in Haryana is the setting of 32749's handpicking scene.
Why we separate at all - Nani's reason that the grains be fit for cooking - which 32749 identifies as the chapter's first answer.
Pebbles out of soil by size is sieving, and 32752 names exactly this construction-site use.
Crane-mounted magnets lifting scrap iron from waste is the industrial note inside 32760.
Size, colour and shape as handpicking's basis - 32749's own criterion.
The soop bamboo tray belongs to the winnowing section, 32751.
Threshers are named in 32751's closing note.
A sieve removing bran and small stones from flour - 32752.
The stated rule: sieving is for a solid-solid mixture whose components differ in size - 32752.
Solution is defined in Activity 9.2, where salt is stirred into water until it dissolves - 32753. 32754 reheats that same solution but does not name it.
Ayurvedic shade drying to evaporate excess water is the note carried by 32754.
Definition of sedimentation - 32756, which gives it with decantation as one operation.
Definition of decantation (tilting the vessel) - 32756. 32755 is the tea-leaf demonstration before the words are supplied.
Filter paper with very fine pores, introduced in 32757 after the cloth.
Filtrate is named only in 32757, at Activity 9.4.
The convenience condition for handpicking - small quantities, easily picked - 32749.
Farmers beating stalks on a wooden log is 32750's field scene.
The sieve's principle plus the bran-from-flour example, both from 32752.
Oil forming a separate layer and being decanted is the cross-reference 32756 makes back to Materials Around Us.
Filtration named at the tea strainer - 32756. The filter-paper mechanics would be 32757, but this item's apparatus is the strainer.
Pores between woven threads making cloth a filter - 32757's opening reason.
Cotton, charcoal and sand as filters, chosen by particle size - the note inside 32757.
Recyclers' crane magnets pulling iron from waste heaps - 32760's industrial note.
The purpose of separating - removing what is undesirable, keeping what is useful - which 32749 establishes with Nani's answer.
Magnetic against non-magnetic substances, both defined in 32760.
The advantage of a thresher over doing both jobs by hand: 32751's note is the only place the machine appears.
Iron filings from sugar by magnet, with sugar named non-magnetic - 32760's definitions.
The black peppers picked out of the pulao is 32750's opening, where Valli names it handpicking. 32749 supplies the colour/shape criterion, but this scene belongs to 32750.
The answer is butter plus buttermilk from churning, which is 32759's content; the 'two useful components' framing comes from 32749 but nothing else in the item does.
Describing winnowing with an agricultural example - 32751, the wind-and-soop section.
Filter paper folded into a funnel, mud as residue and clear water as filtrate - Activity 9.4, held by 32757.
